entities.summary: Ayaz Latif Palijo is a politician, lawyer, activist, writer and teacher from Sindh, Pakistan. Palijo is the current president of Qomi Awami Tahreek, central convener and founder of the Sindh Progressive Nationalist Alliance (SPNA), one of the founders and central Secretary General of Grand Democratic Alliance (GDA). Since 2007, he has represented the left, objecting to the division of the southeastern Pakistani province of Sindh.
